CustomField.description: THE STAGE ORDINAL FROM WHICH THIS PERSONA IS EXPECTED, blank for never. Blank is the honest default and not an omission: WHICH personas a stage expects is a methodology statement, and nothing in the captured vendor surface or in any ruling states one, so our seed ships the mechanism with NO GUIDANCE on the content rather than inventing a methodology nobody graded. Same null semantics as the by-stage marker: blank never flags, and blank is never read as stage zero.
CustomField.label: Expected From Stage
